slides.main: 4 food diary mistakes that hide your triggers.
slides.sub: What to do instead, so patterns actually show up.

slides.main: Filling in your diary from memory at bedtime.
slides.sub: Recall is unreliable and full of biases. Log entries straight after eating.

slides.main: Writing down what you ate, but not how much.
slides.sub: A splash of milk in your coffee and a large milkshake are not the same.

slides.main: Blaming only the meal you ate right before.
slides.sub: Food intolerance symptoms usually start a few hours after eating. Look back 24 to 48 hours.
Otherwise bread can look guilty when stress made the difference. Do not cut foods out without advice from a doctor or dietitian.

slides.main: See a doctor if symptoms keep coming back, or if you have:
items: Blood in your stool or black stools
Symptoms that wake you up at night
